content.value:
We’re always looking for ways to improve and protect your digital experience. That is why we’re introducing an easier way to access our platforms.

This enhancement allows the majority of users to log in with their existing Google or Microsoft credentials. It also turns MyN4L into your central gateway, allowing you to move seamlessly between a range of MyN4L tools and N4L platforms – including Support Hub.

What this means for your school or kura

Instead of juggling multiple logins across different systems, you’ll now get:

  • Single login: Use your Google or Microsoft credentials to access multiple N4L platforms via MyN4L.
  • Enhanced security: Stronger protection thanks to in-built two-factor authentication to keep your school data safe.
  • Better self-service: Set up your new password without having to call our Customer Support team.

How to get started

If your school uses Google or Microsoft accounts, please activate your access using your existing credentials to get started. Otherwise ask your school principal or MyN4L administrator to invite you.

If you or your team have any questions during this upgrade, our Customer Support team is here to help.

The post Advisory: Introducing simplified access to N4L services appeared first on Network for Learning | N4L.
